title: Snort and Suricata: signatures and anomaly detection

videos.script: Snort and Suricata are two engines that read the same language. Learn to write a rule for one, and most of the time you have written it for the other. {{language}} In this lesson you will take one rule apart, piece by piece, and see why every piece is there. {{anatomy}} Then a rule that counts. Fifteen logins from one address in a few seconds, and it speaks only after the tenth. {{count}} Then detection with no rule at all: a request that breaks the protocol, and a stranger asking the name server for one host name after another. {{anomaly}} Last, how to quieten a rule for one known system without going blind to everybody else. {{tuning}}
